_why: open-webui (FastAPI backend + SvelteKit/Tailwind v4 frontend). Seamcheck emitted 133 claims (108 css_selector unused, 14 dom_selector unresolved, 4 env_var unused, 4 css_token_use unresolved, 2 dom_attr, 1 css_token_def unused). Judged 35 by reading code: the seed-0 sample of 12 css_selector + 12 dom_selector, all of css_token_use/css_token_def/dom_attr/env_var, plus one extra css_selector (bg-gray-950-90) verified during pattern-checking. 31 of 35 are FALSE; the 4 TRUE ones are 3 env vars consumed only by pip dependencies and 1 genuinely dead CSS class.

css_selector:class:hljs-regexp.why: highlight.js emits hljs-* token classes at runtime; the app highlights code in CodeBlock.svelte and RichTextInput.svelte, so this vendor-theme rule is live. Class names never appear literally in markup.

css_selector:class:hljs-selector-class.why: runtime-generated highlight.js token class (CodeBlock.svelte uses hljs); vendor theme rule in app.css is exercised whenever CSS is highlighted.

css_selector:class:hljs-section.why: runtime-generated highlight.js token class; rule at app.css:673 styles markdown section tokens produced by hljs at runtime.

css_selector:class:hljs-symbol.why: runtime-generated highlight.js token class; applied by the library when highlighting, never present in source markup.

css_selector:class:hljs-name.why: runtime-generated highlight.js token class; applied by the library at runtime.

css_selector:class:hljs-string.why: runtime-generated highlight.js token class; applied by the library at runtime.

css_selector:class:dark:group-hover:bg-g.why: literal class attribute usage in Svelte markup: src/lib/components/layout/Sidebar.svelte:964 (and 4 more sites) has class="... dark:group-hover:bg-gray-900". Tool failed to match Tailwind variant class names (colons, CSS-escaped as \:) against .svelte class attributes.

css_selector:class:dark:text-gray-700.why: used literally in src/lib/components/admin/Users/Groups/GroupItem.svelte:104, Chat.svelte:4496, ToolsSelector.svelte:92, etc. Tailwind variant class in .svelte markup not matched.

css_selector:class:dark:group-hover:text.why: used literally in src/lib/components/chat/AskUserCard.svelte:218. Tailwind variant class in .svelte markup not matched.

css_selector:class:hover-reveal.why: used literally in src/lib/components/common/Folder.svelte:177, Image.svelte:88, and passed as className prop in Sidebar.svelte:1228/1249. Plain class in .svelte class attributes not matched by the usage scan.

css_selector:class:animated.why: @xyflow/svelte adds class 'animated' to edge elements at runtime when the edge object has animated:true — set in src/lib/components/chat/Overview/View.svelte:124. Rule .svelte-flow__edge.animated (app.css:400) is live.

css_selector:class:is-editor-empty.why: TipTap Placeholder extension (configured in src/lib/components/common/RichTextInput.svelte:799) adds its default emptyEditorClass 'is-editor-empty' at runtime; app.css:428 styles the placeholder via it.

css_selector:class:bg-gray-950-90.why: defined at src/app.css:405 and a full-repo grep (excluding node_modules) finds zero other references in markup, JS, or HTML — genuinely dead selector.

css_token_use:token:--color-gray-500.why: defined in src/tailwind.css:18 inside the Tailwind v4 @theme block, which the build emits as a :root custom property. Tool did not credit @theme definitions.

css_token_use:token:--color-gray-700.why: defined in src/tailwind.css:20 (@theme block). Same @theme-not-parsed pattern.

css_token_use:token:--color-gray-200.why: defined in src/tailwind.css:15 (@theme block); also consumed at tailwind.css:41.

css_token_def:token:--color-gray-850.why: the app.html:62 runtime setProperty is the OLED-dark theme override; it is consumed by Tailwind-v4-compiled utilities (e.g. dark:!bg-gray-850 in src/routes/+layout.svelte:1435 compiles to background-color: var(--color-gray-850)). Usage lives in build-generated CSS the source scan cannot see; the token is also defined in tailwind.css:22 @theme.

dom_selector:data:type:src/app.css:444.why: ul[data-type='taskList'] — data-type is set by the TipTap TaskList extension at runtime AND literally in JS template-literal HTML at src/lib/components/common/RichTextInput.svelte:14,25,507. Tool only recognizes markup/setAttribute forms.

dom_selector:data:type:src/app.css:574.why: same attribute: data-type set via TipTap TaskList renderHTML and HTML-in-JS strings (RichTextInput.svelte:14).

dom_selector:data:type:src/app.css:481.why: same: TipTap TaskList emits ul[data-type=taskList] at runtime; also set in template-literal HTML in RichTextInput.svelte.

dom_selector:data:type:src/app.css:486.why: same data-type attribute; set by TipTap extension runtime + JS string HTML.

dom_selector:data:type:src/app.css:766.why: same data-type attribute; set by TipTap extension runtime + JS string HTML.

dom_selector:data:type:src/app.css:537.why: same data-type attribute; set by TipTap extension runtime + JS string HTML.

dom_selector:data:type:src/app.css:579.why: same data-type attribute; set by TipTap extension runtime + JS string HTML.

dom_selector:data:checked:src/app.css:56.why: li[data-checked] — set by TipTap TaskItem at runtime and literally in a JS template literal at src/lib/components/common/RichTextInput.svelte:25 (data-checked="${checkedAttr}"); also read via getAttribute at lines 106-109.

dom_selector:data:checked:src/app.css:47.why: same data-checked attribute, set by TipTap TaskItem runtime + RichTextInput.svelte:25 template literal.

dom_selector:data:theme:src/app.css:378.why: .tippy-box[data-theme~='dark'] — tippy.js writes data-theme onto its box element from the theme option; src/lib/components/common/Tooltip.svelte:61 passes theme:'dark'. Library sets the attribute from a JS config prop.

dom_selector:data:theme:src/app.css:717.why: same: tippy.js sets data-theme at runtime from the theme option ('transparent' used across components).

dom_selector:data:prompt:src/lib/compone.why: the same file sets it: AutoCompletion.js:114 assigns 'data-prompt': prompt through TipTap's attributes/renderHTML object, which puts the attribute on the DOM. Setter is an object-literal key, not setAttribute/markup.

dom_attr:data:sveltekit-preload-data:src.why: data-sveltekit-preload-data="hover" is a documented SvelteKit framework attribute; the framework runtime reads it to control link preloading. Consumer is the dependency, and the attribute is definitely live.

dom_attr:class:bg-white:src/app.html:194.why: bg-white is a Tailwind utility; Tailwind's build scans app.html and emits .bg-white into the compiled stylesheet. No source .css defines it, but the built CSS does.

env_var:FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS.why: read inside the repo via shell parameter expansion: backend/start.sh:75 and :112, backend/dev.sh:3 (${FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS:-*}), backend/start_windows.bat:27. Tool missed ${VAR:-default} reads in shell/batch scripts.

env_var:ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY.why: not read anywhere in the repo; consumed by the chromadb dependency (pyproject.toml:68) to disable its telemetry. The note's hedge ('consumed by something outside the repo') is exactly right — repo-scoped claim is accurate, though deleting it would re-enable telemetry.

env_var:DO_NOT_TRACK.why: not read in-repo; it is the cross-ecosystem DNT convention honored by several dependencies. Claim is accurate as scoped and properly hedged.

env_var:SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS.why: not read in-repo; consumed by the scarf analytics tooling used by dependencies. Claim accurate as scoped and properly hedged.
